title: Cosmological Tensions in a Gauge-Invariant Modified Gravity (Tabatabaei, Rahvar, Rouhani)
efc_relevance: GIMOG: gravitational interaction emerges from a scalar field after a first-order phase transition, generating a pre-inflationary phase and late-time acceleration without an explicit cosmological constant. Same dual-regime ambition as EFC's L0→L3 spine (early→late from a single mechanism), but routed through a phase-transition scalar rather than EFC's S(r,t) entropy-flow. Authors flag a tension between BBN-allowed and late-time-required coupling strengths — a constraint EFC must demonstrate it does not share.
ledger_action: Add to External Research Ledger under cluster modified-gravity as 2026 emergent-scalar competitor; cross-reference framework:fR-Starobinsky2007, arXiv:2604.19545 (BBN bound on generalised entropies) and arXiv:2604.23793 (f(Q,L_m) BBN-to-late); required head-to-head row in WP1 recovery-conditions on the BBN-vs-late-time coupling consistency.
